basic_info.description: 2801 Octavia Street #1 features an open floor plan which feeds a private (exclusive use) 189 square foot deck, serving as a seamless extension of the living space. The unit features a king-sized bedroom, huge walk-in closet, updated bathroom with shower over tub, and three bonus closets. With beautiful hardwood floors throughout and plenty of natural sunlight, this is a sophisticated urban home. The unit is just one of four in this impeccably maintained boutique building. With your own garage entrance just a dozen or so steps from your front door, there really are no "common areas", making this a true home. The building is in the heart of Cow Hollow. Step out the front door, swing a quick right and you're on historic Union Street, home to fine restaurants and up-scale boutiques. If you're looking for a true home that offers quintessential City living in one of San Francisco's great neighborhoods, this is it. The unit also comes with storage (basement). The deck was rebuilt this month (February 2025) and the building was painted last quarter, level setting the HOA (no deferred maintenance) which covers everything but a small unit utility bill and H06 insurance.
